plan.usage: plan takes new | list | show | add | link | set | rm | accept | reject | review
plan.badSlug: Plan name "{slug}" is not valid: use 1-40 characters from a-z, 0-9 and -
plan.noNode: No plan node "{node}" (use an id such as n2, or Lnn for a line without an id)
plan.tooMany: A plan holds at most {max} nodes
plan.tooDeep: Plans nest at most {max} levels deep
plan.hasChildren: Node {node} has children; remove or move them first (rm takes a leaf only)
plan.tooBig: Plan {slug} is larger than {max} KiB; split it before changing it
plan.notFound: No plan named "{slug}" (see: crew plan list)
plan.notProposed: Node {node} is not a proposed node; accept only applies to [?]
plan.empty: No plans. Start one with: crew plan new SLUG --title "..."
plan.head: {slug}: {title}  {pct}% ({done}/{total} steps done)
plan.truncated: (the plan is larger than the display limit; only the first part is shown)
plan.dupIds: Warning: these ids are used more than once (the first one wins; the next write gives the others new ids): {ids}
plan.review.usage: plan review takes run | submit | filter | finalize | show
plan.review.dispatch: Dispatch the {agent} subagent (model {model}) for plan {slug}, plan review round {round}, with the prompt below (Agent tool, read-only).
plan.review.rawAt: The findings will be stored as {path}
plan.review.thenFilter: When it has saved its findings, run: crew plan review filter {slug}
plan.review.filtered: Plan review round {round}: {total} findings, {kept} kept, {dropped} dropped
plan.review.nothingToRefute: Nothing left to refute. Close the round with: crew plan review finalize {slug}
plan.review.finalized: Plan review round {round}: {n} proposed nodes added ({refuted} refuted, {cut} cut by the per-round limit)
plan.review.deepNote: note: {id} would nest deeper than {max} levels, so it was attached under {under} (the deepest allowed level)
plan.review.decide: Decide each one: crew plan accept {slug} <node>   or   crew plan reject {slug} <node> --note "why"
plan.review.roundRow: Round {round} ({date}, {status}): raised {raised}, refuted {refuted}, kept {kept}, cut {cut}, accepted {accepted}, rejected {rejected}
plan.review.accepted.add: Node {id} accepted: it is now an open step
plan.review.accepted.split: Node {id} accepted: it is now an open step
plan.review.accepted.change: Node {id} accepted: step {target} was reworded and the proposal removed
plan.review.accepted.drop: Node {id} accepted: step {target} is dropped and the proposal removed
plan.review.rejected: Node {id} rejected; later review rounds will not raise it again
plan.review.growth: Plan {slug} has grown by {count} accepted proposals since the last large_task approval (limit {limit}). The large_task gate applies: ask the user first (crew gate ask large_task), then record the answer.
planReview.maxRounds: Plan {slug} has had {max} plan review rounds already (plan.max_rounds); add --force to run another
planReview.alreadyFinalized: Plan review round {round} is already finalized; start a new round with: crew plan review run
planReview.noRefutations: No refutations for round {round} yet (submit them with --kind refutations, or pass --refutations-file)
planReview.targetGone: Proposal {node} is about step {target}, which is gone or dropped; reject it instead
